module_power_note: protocol §4 module power = VDD_GPU_SOC + VDD_CPU_CV + VIN_SYS_5V0 + VDDQ_VDD2_1V8AO. tegrastats prints only the first three on this carrier board, so power_idle.csv (tegrastats) has three rails and power_idle_sysfs.csv has all four. Use the sysfs file for the four-rail sum.
